fields.label: Wait per Character
fields.description: Game-frame counter added per flushed text-buffer character for auto-forward. The page counter starts at zero, accumulates buffer.length * WaitPerChar, and is decremented when auto confirmation is polled during a pause. Use a number >=1; fractional values are accepted, but this is an update counter, not wall-clock seconds. See EXT-BEH-autoforward for enabling AUTO and minimum delay.

fields.label: Minimum Wait
fields.description: Minimum auto-forward counter applied at each pause: max(accumulated character delay, MinimumWait). It is not an extra delay added to WaitPerChar. entries.title: autoforward
entries.context: Configure /Buttons/List with a JSON array of button names; it replaces the list, so include every button you want to retain. Set /MsgButtonConsole/ShowDefault to the JavaScript source string "true" for new-game visibility, or use the MsgButtonConsole plugin command with Visible="true" for current saved state. Buttons are shown with map messages, follow window openness, and accept clicks/touch only when visible and fully open. AutoSizeHide and <HIDE BUTTON CONSOLE> can hide them. Use ext-message parameters set with --project pointing to the game, reload the editor and restart the game after parameter writes. Add "auto" to /Buttons/List and click AUTO during a map message, or configure /Buttons/AutoKey with an existing MZ input symbol and press it. Toggle again to disable. /Auto/WaitPerChar is game frames added per flushed text-buffer character; /Auto/MinimumWait is the minimum counter at a pause. The counter resets at each new page and decrements when auto confirmation is polled during a pause. Ordinary confirm input cancels auto and confirms the pause. Auto does not choose items, numbers or choices. Both auto and extended fast-forward toggles reset when the map has no running event; the battle reset also checks the map event state. The local timer does not wait for voice playback. For providers, activation and whole-group authoring, see ext-message api describe EXT-M-015 --json. The CLI authors data offline; effects occur only in the running game. Cursor/tail settings and console visibility belong to Game_System: commands survive map changes and save/load, and new games initialize from the current configuration. Old saves missing an entire settings owner initialize it from current defaults; existing partial owners are preserved, not merged. Parameter edits do not replace settings already present in a loaded save. Auto/fast-forward toggles belong to Game_Temp, are not saved, and reset on a new game/load; their additional in-game reset rules are described at EXT-BEH-autoforward and EXT-BEH-fastforward.
